gloss: Mori Ogai (Meiji novelist and army doctor)

definitions.explanation: A novelist, translator and army surgeon who studied medicine in Germany and rose to the top medical post in the army. With Natsume Soseki he is ranked as one of the two great writers of the Meiji era. Known for {舞姫|まいひめ}, {高瀬舟|たかせぶね} and {雁|がん}.
